Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE IX OF 2000
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE IX OF 2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Elections
Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of N.-W. F.
P., Extraordinary, 14th December, 2000]
No.
Legis.1(18)/70-VIII/7360/7390, dated 14-12-2000. The following Ordinance by
the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information.---
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Local Government Elections (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Insertion of section 18A to N.W.F.P. Ord. VI of 2000

ORDINANCE IX OF 2000
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE IX OF 2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Elections
Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of N.-W. F.
P., Extraordinary, 14th December, 2000]
No.
Legis.1(18)/70-VIII/7360/7390, dated 14-12-2000. The following Ordinance by
the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information.---
2. Insertion of section 18A to
N.-W.F.P. Ord. VI of 2000.--In the North-West Frontier Province Local
Government Elections Ordinance, 2000 (N.-W.F.P. Ord. No. VI of 2000),
hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, after section 18, the following
new section shall be inserted namely:
"18A. Casual
vacancy.-(1) If the seat of a member becomes vacant during the term of
office of a Council, a new member shall be elected through bye-election and
such member shall hold office for the remaining part of such term, provided
that all bye-elections shall be held once a year on dates fixed by the Chief
Election Commissioner.
(2) The vacancy in the office of
Nazim shall be filled by officiating Nazim elected by the members of the
Council concerned by a majority vote; provided that;
(a) the member
so elected shall continue to hold his substantive office as member till the
bye-election to fill the vacant office is held;
(b) a Naib Nazim
will not be eligible for bye-election or for officiating as Nazim; and
(c) in the event
of temporary absence of a Nazim, the Naib Nazim of the Council concerned shall
deputize in place of the Nazim."

[Gazette of N.-W. F.
P., Extraordinary, 14th December, 2000]
No.
Legis.1(18)/70-VIII/7360/7390, dated 14-12-2000. The following Ordinance by
the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information.---
3. Insertion of section 35-A
to N.-W.F.P. Ord. No. VI of 2000.--In the said Ordinance after section 35,
the following new section shall be inserted namely:--
"35A. Power
of the Chief Election Commissioner to punish for contempt.--The Chief
Election Commissioner shall have the same power as the High Court has to punish
any person for contempt of Court and the Contempt of Court Act, 1976 (XLVI of
1976) shall have effect accordingly as if reference therein to a
"Judge" was reference to the "Chief Election Commissioner."
